headline: Is Qorvo (QRVO) Getting Too Expensive After Its 32% Rally?
summary: Qorvo has ridden a strong share price recovery this year, and the stock now sits inside a much larger combined chip group after its acquisition by Skyworks Solutions. That combination puts fresh attention on a simple question for Qorvo investors today: whether the current price is supported by the cash the business can generate over time.
